notes.title: "Card Quest" "Path of Self-Renewal" update is ready to launch!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!
This is your Card Ques frontline reporter~ Thank you all for your continued support and love. Our card game has been officially launched on Steam and other platforms for over a month. During this time, we have been constantly gathering feedback from adventurers, whether it's about gameplay experience, visual feelings, or in-game characters.
We have not only fixed the bugs encountered during the gameplay but also started a race against time to schedule and produce version 2.0. We have named the new version "Path of Self-Renewal" (Note - Path of Self-Renewal: It signifies self-improvement and starting anew). Let's take a look at the upcoming updates with the frontline reporter. The game 2.0 version will be updated on December 18th (Beijing time).

〓NO.1: Known BUG Issues〓
 Regarding bugs, we will definitely feedback to our technical team as soon as we see them on any platform for investigation and repair. All known bugs encountered by adventurers are being actively addressed, in addition to those already fixed. If you have any questions or feedback about the gaming experience, you can leave a message in the comment section of the platform.

〓NO.2: All Six Characters Online〓 
In this update: Silver Knight - Night, Order Mage - Maria, Night Guardian - Peng Peng, will all be launched at the same time; this is the first time that Bracket Boy, Headmaster, and Card Maze T0 are meeting you adventurers, please be kind and give us your guidance~

〓NO.3: Level Mode Experience Update〓 
Based on the feedback we received about the chapter gameplay, the guidance and progressive relationship in this update will be more apparent, allowing both new and old adventurers to have a smoother experience, with new gameplay and content added as the level increases within the chapter. At the same time, we have made other optimizations; once you clear all the content of the first level of Chapter 1, you will unlock not only the second level of Chapter 1 but also the first level of Chapter 2.

〓NO.4: Brand New UI Interface〓 
The main UI and character UI display have undergone significant changes. The main UI has become more concise and easy to operate, with increased interactivity, such as being able to use the mouse or keyboard to control the display and closure of various icons, and when viewing character skills, you can click on the skill name to see a detailed description, etc. The character UI has been redesigned and added according to the characteristics of each cat, with each cat having its own little world when idle. You can see different scenes by switching characters on the main interface. No matter the wind or rain, the cats are waiting for you in "Card Ques"!!!

〓NO.5: Other Content Updates〓 
In addition to the new content mentioned above, we have also made some optimizations for a better gaming experience since the launch, and the development team is ready to listen!
(1)Optimization of the beginner's guide; we will continue to listen to the feedback from adventurers, and we welcome your feedback! 
(2)Equipment wearing: can be done by right-clicking the mouse or clicking to wear on the equipment page. 
(3) Monster Meow skill viewing: by placing the mouse over the special (skill) icon on the Monster Meow card, you can view its detailed information.

〓NO.6: Future Update Plans〓 
The first priority will still be to address any bugs or issues encountered during the gameplay; we will also update the addition of all levels of Chapter 3 and other content in the future. For more detailed information, please continue to follow our official announcements and sections.

As night falls, Eileen grips her staff tightly, raising her head and gazing resolutely at the increasingly nightmarish scene. notes.title: A letter from the producer|Written on the Eve of the Game's Release
notes.content:
As I look at the release time for tomorrow's game on the computer,
     I realize we've been working toward this day for three years, yet it feels like just one day has passed. I still remember the day we kicked off the project in early 2021. Back then, neither I nor the lead planner, Qian Ren, had the idea of making an indie PC game. Our initial consensus was only to complete a very small-scale product for a short-term goal. Later, with the addition of Teacher Paomian and the application for the publishing license, more resources started pouring in, and our ambitions grew larger. (Looking back, this decision marked the beginning of our three-year-long "Shura trial.")
     The development process was full of twists and turns, with constant shortages of people, funds, and resources, pushing the team to the brink of confusion and collapse several times. In some ways, this definitely wasn't a commercially valuable thing. However, for us, it has been a life experience worth remembering.
     There are always regrets during development, but when you work hard, surprises are inevitable too. From the launch of the demo to the lead-up to the New Game Festival, our promotional budget was limited, so not many players got a chance to try the demo. But once the festival started, more and more players began adding the game to their wishlists. Some of the players who had played the demo reached out to share their thoughts, and one even spent over 40 hours in the demo alone. All of this gave us a lot of positive feedback.
     Card Quest may never become a phenomenon-level game, but for us, it's a project into which we've poured immense passion and all our efforts.
     We love its gameplay, its art style, and its story in the artbook. Regardless of the final outcome, at the very least, we persisted and completed all the designs we could at this stage.
     Just like in the game when Ace says to Aileen:
     Light and darkness always go hand in hand, as do despair and hope. In the end, I just want to say, no matter when.
     whenever you open Card Quest, brew yourself a cup of tea or coffee, and enjoy embarking on this dreamlike adventure.

notes.title: "Card Quest" Demo Play FAQ Guide
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers, the "Card Quest" Demo play will officially start tomorrow at 10:00 AM（Beijing Time）. Here is the FAQ guide, please read it carefully.

▶Basic Information of the Demo Play◀ 
Play Time: July 25th at 10:00 AM （Beijing Time）
Demo Platform: PC - Steam Platform 
Demo Type: "Card Quest" Tutorial Chapter & First Chapter Easy Mode Demo Play

▶Game Experience Related◀ 
Q: What content can be experienced in this demo? What is the core gameplay?
1、In this Demo, you can experience the Tutorial Chapter & First Chapter mode. Tutorial Chapter: Allows adventurers to understand the game settings, gameplay, and strategic elements; divided into four levels. First Chapter - Forbidden Forest Marsh, core gameplay "Random Dice": Gain advantageous effects (numbers) based on dice rolls to secure the initiative in battle (attack), open treasure chests to obtain supplies, etc.
2、Characters available for experience: Dream Hunter Swordsman - Ace, Dream Guide Mage - Eileen.
3、Treasure chest gameplay: Randomly obtain character enhancement materials, dream spring water, runes, gold coins, and other supplies (guaranteed to get supplies with each draw). *More chapter gameplay and available characters will be available soon~ (*❦ω❦) 

Q: How to participate in this Demo play? 
Search for "Card Quest" in the Steam store to see the demo option, and add it to your wishlist to keep up with official news.

Q: How to upgrade weapons in the game? 
Weapons in the levels can be upgraded and broken through using Soul Stones, but weapons will not be taken out of the level after each round. So just consider the in-level strategy for upgrading weapons, armor, and accessories.

Q: How to view the skill information of monsters and BOSSes within the level? Monsters and BOSSes can be viewed by right-clicking on their cards (the first time you unlock BOSS and monster information within the level, you can get a corresponding gold coin reward).

Q: How to turn off BGM and other sound effects in the game? 
Click on the top right corner of the game - Settings - Adjust sound effects & background music.

▶Common Questions of the Demo Play◀ 
Q: What are the PC configuration requirements? 
You can check the configuration requirements for Windows and macOS on the Steam store page.

Q: Is an accelerator needed for this demo play? 
No accelerator is needed to play the demo.

Q: What to do if the game fails to launch or encounters other game operation issues? 
(1)After confirming that the PC meets the requirements, try updating the graphics card driver / cleaning up memory or disk space, etc. 
(2)Try turning off the computer's antivirus / security defense software. 
(3)You can right-click in the Steam library - Game - Properties - Verify the integrity of the game.
